name: assistant
title: AI assistant
summary: Chat with an AI assistant that reads the user's data in the app and in services they connected, through scoped tools, with streamed replies, approval for outside changes, quotas, consent and reporting.

env.name: ASSISTANT_PROVIDER
env.doc: AI provider: anthropic, openai, or mock (scripted replies, development only).

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.doc: Anthropic API key; without it (and with ASSISTANT_PROVIDER=anthropic) assistant routes return 503.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.doc: OpenAI API key, used when ASSISTANT_PROVIDER=openai.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
env.doc: Anthropic API base URL (change only for a proxy that passes beta fields through).

env.name: ASSISTANT_MODEL
env.doc: Chat model; defaults to claude-sonnet-5-5 (anthropic) or gpt-6-sol (openai).

env.name: ASSISTANT_TITLE_MODEL
env.doc: Cheaper model for titles and history summaries; defaults to claude-haiku-5-5 (anthropic) or gpt-6-luna (openai).

env.name: ASSISTANT_EFFORT
env.doc: Reasoning effort for chat turns: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

env.name: ASSISTANT_ANTHROPIC_FALLBACK
env.doc: Ask Anthropic to retry a refused turn on its recommended fallback model (turn off for models without server-side fallback).

env.name: ASSISTANT_ALLOW_WRITES
env.doc: Offer the model tools that change data (ReadOnly=false); read-only tools are always offered.

env.name: ASSISTANT_MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS
env.doc: Rounds of tool calls per reply before the model must answer.

env.name: ASSISTANT_CONTEXT_TOKENS
env.doc: Prompt size in tokens past which earlier turns are compacted into a summary.

env.name: ASSISTANT_DAILY_MESSAGES
env.doc: Messages per user per UTC day (0 = unlimited; admins are unlimited).

env.name: ASSISTANT_DAILY_TOKENS
env.doc: Tokens per user per UTC day, excluding cache reads (0 = unlimited).

env.name: ASSISTANT_MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS
env.doc: Longest user message accepted, in characters.

env.name: ASSISTANT_TURN_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Longest a single reply may run, tool calls included.

wire.insert: import { assistantAdminNav, assistantHomeTile, assistantNav, assistantSettings } from "./assistant/nav";

stitch: Rewrite the product sections of staticPrompt in backend/internal/assistant/prompt.go (identity, scope, writing) for this app; keep Trust and safety unchanged.
Name the AI provider and what is sent to it in the privacy policy (packages/shared/src/legal) before launch.

Decide ASSISTANT_ALLOW_WRITES: leave it off unless the app's write tools are safe for a model to call on the user's say-so. With the agents feature installed, turn it on and let each user's AI agent scope decide (read only by default). External tools from connected services follow each connection's changes switch and per-call approval instead.
Set daily limits (ASSISTANT_DAILY_MESSAGES, ASSISTANT_DAILY_TOKENS) from your cost model, and add a prices row in pricing.go for any model you configure that isn't listed.
Make sure each feature you want the assistant to use implements app.ToolProvider with clear, prescriptive tool descriptions.
Mobile: the assistant is a Home row; if it is central to the app, give it a tab in mobile/app/(tabs) instead.
